raw_meta_yaml:
{% set name = "cfg-cli" %}
{% set version = "0.1.32" %}

package:
  name: "{{ name|lower }}"
  version: "{{ version }}"

source:
  url: "https://pypi.io/packages/source/{{ name[0] }}/{{ name }}/{{ name }}-{{ version }}.tar.gz"
  sha256: 0786048d63e5b66338307fb9739142aa06a090744e00141c95c0b8054b4c767b

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: python
  entry_points:
    - prism = cfg_cli.prism_cli:wrapper
  script: "{{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv"

requirements:
  host:
    - pip
    - python >=3.6
    - poetry
  run:
    - boto3 >=1.14.11,<2.0.0
    - fire >=0.2.1,<0.3.0
    - importlib-metadata >=1.7.0,<2.0.0
    - prompt-toolkit >=3.0.5,<4.0.0
    - python >=3.6
    - python-jose >=3.1.0,<4.0.0
    - requests >=2.23.0,<3.0.0
    - tabulate >=0.8.7,<0.9.0

test:
  imports:
    - cfg_cli
    - cfg_cli.clients
    - cfg_cli.errors
  commands:
    - prism --help

about:
  home: "https://github.com/CofactorGenomics/immunoprism-cli"
  license: MIT
  license_family: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: "Command-line tool for Cofactor Genomics' products and services."
  doc_url: "https://cofactorgenomics.github.io"

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - alexbode
    - davemessina
